existing_instructions.purpose: Short durable learnings that are one to four sentences and refine existing guidance.
current_learning_topics: prefer learner-facing wording in course release notes
keep accessibility review evidence close to release tickets

existing_instructions.purpose: Always-on course writing conventions for objective wording, tone, and terminology.
current_learning_topics: write learning objectives as observable learner actions
avoid unexplained acronyms in beginner modules

existing_skills.name: course-quality-checks
existing_skills.purpose: Runs checklist-style reviews for individual course assets after a release plan already exists.
existing_skills.gap: Does not provide the update-skills decision workflow, evidence capture pattern, or skill-vs-instruction reasoning for a new durable learning.

existing_skills.name: video-accessibility-review
existing_skills.purpose: Checks video captions, transcripts, and audio-description readiness for a single media lesson.
existing_skills.gap: Too narrow for LMS metadata, rubric alignment, reviewer notes, and publishing-contract decisions.

capture_policy.add_learning_to_existing_instruction: Use only when the insight is small, one to four sentences, and naturally extends an existing instruction.
capture_policy.update_existing_skill: Use when the new learning clearly belongs to an existing skill's scope without changing its core purpose.
capture_policy.create_new_skill: Use when the learning is substantial, multi-step, evidence-driven, and covers a distinct workflow future agents should invoke by name.
capture_policy.create_new_instruction: Use when the rule should apply automatically based on file patterns or globally without needing an invoked workflow.
